title: AEP Multi-Solution Architect
fit_note: End-to-end architecture role spanning the full AEP stack (RT-CDP, AJO, CJA, Target) — designing high-level/low-level architecture, integration patterns with CRM/OCS/CMS/loyalty systems, and governance/compliance, while acting as technical authority for implementation teams. Strong match for the strategic-but-still-hands-on architect profile Patrick wants, and fully remote so location is a non-issue. Caveat: posted via TechBiz Global, an IT recruitment agency, for an undisclosed end client — worth clarifying who the actual employer is before applying.

title: Adobe Technology Consultant & Digital Practice Lead
fit_note: Senior leadership role driving EPAM's European Adobe technology consulting and growth strategy — explicitly described as wearing multiple hats (director of technology, senior technical consultant, account CTO, or Chief Architect) and leading technology consulting, architecture engagements, and major transformations through execution. Strong match for the desired shift toward strategy while staying technical/hands-on, in EPAM's Zurich Adobe practice (which already has an open Adobe Campaign Solution Architect role tracked separately). Caveat: exact remote/hybrid split wasn't confirmed from search results, and the role carries a business-development/practice-growth component alongside the architecture work.

title: Senior Associate – Marketing Technology Specialist
fit_note: In-house martech strategy role owning PwC Switzerland's marketing technology roadmap and leading modernisation of the marketing tech ecosystem, explicitly including migration to platforms like Adobe Experience Platform — 6-8+ years in marketing technology/digital platforms required, and the role also covers CRM/CMS/automation and data governance partnering with Data & Analytics. Caveat: this is a strategy/roadmap-owner role inside PwC's internal marketing org rather than a pure hands-on architect position, and scope is broader than just Adobe/CDP (also covers general martech stack) — worth confirming how much hands-on AEP work is actually involved versus vendor/roadmap oversight.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant, CXO (Customer Experience Orchestration)
fit_note: Senior pre-sales Solutions Consultant role at Adobe itself covering Customer Experience Orchestration (Real-Time CDP, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Customer Journey Analytics) for enterprise accounts out of Zurich — pairs deep technical/architecture credibility with strategic customer-facing work, matching the move toward strategy without losing the hands-on component. Requires 8+ years in Solution Consulting or comparable pre-sales roles. Note: this same requisition (R169096) has been tracked and auto-expired from this list twice before — it appears to be a long-standing/evergreen Adobe opening that stays posted for months, so it keeps cycling back into the 14-day tracker window.

title: Solution Architect - Adobe Experience Cloud
fit_note: Architect-level role at Netcentric (Cognizant's Adobe Platinum Solution Partner, HQ'd in Zurich) covering Adobe Experience Platform/Adobe Experience Cloud solution design — a technical, still hands-on architecture role at 5-7+ years seniority, matching Patrick's desire to stay technical while moving up. Caveat: exact remote/hybrid split for this specific requisition wasn't confirmed from search results (Netcentric describes agile remote-working with a Zurich studio), and scope leans more Adobe Experience Cloud/AEM-adjacent than pure AEP/CJA/AJO — worth checking the listing directly for stack details.

title: Product Specialist, Data and Customer Journey
fit_note: Senior pre-sales product specialist role at Adobe itself, covering the Data and Customer Journey portfolio (Real-Time CDP, Customer Journey Analytics, Adobe Journey Optimizer) — same strategic-but-still-technical profile as the CXO Solutions Consultant role already tracked, based out of Zurich (listed as "Remote, Zurich, Switzerland"). Caveat: exact seniority bar and hybrid/remote split not fully confirmed from search results, but comparable Adobe "Product Specialist" roles require 5+ years of enterprise software pre-sales experience.

title: AEP Enterprise Architect (EMEA)

Caveat: search results gave conflicting signals on remote eligibility — one source ties the EMEA posting to London, another labels a similarly-named posting "United States Remote" with US-work-authorization language; could not confirm whether this specific requisition is open to Switzerland-based remote applicants.

title: CDP Solution Architect / Technical Customer Engagement Manager
fit_note: Architect-level Customer Data Platform role (Bloomreach Engagement CDP + marketing tech ecosystem) on the Customer Engagement team, hybrid in Zurich — matches Patrick's location and CDP-architecture skill set. Caveat: stated minimum experience (3+ years as CDP solution architect/consultant) is well below Patrick's 9+ years, suggesting the role may be scoped more mid-level despite the "Architect" title, and it's Bloomreach-based rather than Adobe-based.
